## Plan → landed

| planned | landed |
|---|---|
| projection and fit | `figures/projection.py` — deterministic project + viewport fit |
| simplification | `figures/simplify.py` — deterministic ring/line simplification with a minimum-perimeter floor |
| `static-12px@1` binning | `figures/binning.py` — 12-px minimum separation at 1×; deterministic cell assignment |
| H3 areas vs tier-0 points | `figures/binning.py` + `map_figure.py` — H3 areas below the point-zoom threshold; tier-0 points only at framing zoom ≥ 10 when tier/precision permits; the H3 resolution is the finest whose cell diameter honours the record's precision bound |
| tier guards | `figures/model.py` + `binning.py` — tier-3 and infinite-precision records never reach drawing; a spec whose drawable set is empty under the guards refuses, never renders a hollow map |
| outlines and child links | `figures/map_figure.py` — jurisdiction + child outlines; uncovered children render hatched; child links emit as anchors |
| locator and index-sprite data | `figures/locator.py` — locator SVG + index-sprite construction |
| "not drawn" counts | `figures/model.py` typed counters — `declared_no_point`, `located_elsewhere` (per jurisdiction), `conflicting`, `tier3` — aggregate metadata only, no raw record data |
| byte-deterministic output | `figures/paths.py` + `serialize.py` — stable ordering, fixed precision, canonical attribute order; standalone renders byte-identical across runs |
| CSP-safe serializer | `figures/serialize.py` — refuses `<script>`, `on*` attributes, external/fetch references, malformed markup; `xmlns` namespace identifiers are not fetches |
| accessibility | `figures/map_figure.py` — `<title>`, `<desc>`, `role="img"`, `aria-labelledby` on every figure |
| standalone renderer | `figures/standalone.py` — P36.19-compatible document: internal styles only, light + dark token variables, print forces light |
| one kit, one vocabulary | `figures/lexicon.py` + `tokens.py` — classes/variables resolve through `lexicon.json` and the token mirror; `sig-fig-contested` carries the reserved disagreement hue on a semantically named class |
| ADR-157 (S4c) | `docs/adr/ADR-157-one-static-figure-kit-geography.md` + registrations (ADR_TRIGGERS, appF, spec rebuild, BL-086, adr index) |
| CLI | `sig-exports figure map|locator|sprite` — spec JSON → SVG (+ optional metadata JSON, optional standalone wrap); refusal exits 4, no partial output |

## Deviations (recorded, not smoothed)

1. **The CLI verb is `sig-exports figure map|locator|sprite`,** one
   subcommand family with three verbs — the ticket names the
   capability, not the spelling; the three figure kinds share the
   spec-JSON-in / SVG-out / refuse-closed contract.
2. **`sig-fig-contested`, not a generic marker class.** The reserved
   disagreement/provisional hues are lexicon-bound semantics; a
   generic `sig-fig-marker` selector carrying the disagreement hue
   failed the reserved-hue unit leg — renamed so the class itself
   declares the semantics (SIG-UI-134's honest-state rule).
3. **The SVG `xmlns` is a namespace identifier, not an external
   reference.** The CSP check rejects fetch targets (`href`, `src`,
   `url(...)`, `@import`) while permitting the required
   `xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"` declaration.
